response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript, cloud, and production-systems background, plus recent hands-on work with MCP servers and agentic tooling. However, his AI-specific experience is only about a year and the resume shows no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, data pipelines for ML, evaluation/observability frameworks for AI systems, or Python — all core requirements for this staff-level GenAI role. He may be a fit if the recent AI work is deeper than described, but on paper he falls short of the 8+ years of AI-driven development required.
strengths: 15+ years of production software experience across web, backend, and infrastructure, including staff-level roles
Recent hands-on experience with MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks at re:cinq
Strong engineering-excellence culture (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, conference talks) matching the mentorship expectations
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI/GenAI experience versus the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation pipelines, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI
Python is not listed among his skills, and there is little demonstrated data-pipeline or enterprise customer-facing consulting experience

key_factors.factor: Recent MCP and agentic tooling experience
